id: custom.id.clone(),\n237\t                        regex,\n238\t                        keywords: None,\n239\t                        secret_group,\n240\t                        entropy_threshold: custom.entropy,\n241\t                        allowlist_regexes: Vec::new(),\n242\t                        allowlist_stopwords: HashSet::new(),\n243\t                    });\n244\t                }\n245\t                Err(e) => {\n246\t                    tracing::warn!(\n247\t                        pattern_id = %custom.id,\n248\t                        error = %e,\n249\t                        \"custom sanitization pattern failed to compile, skipping\"\n250\t                    );\n251\t                }\n252\t            }\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Known-safe passthrough: these substrings in the *secret* portion mean\n256\t        // we skip redaction unconditionally.\n257\t        let safe_passthrough = AhoCorasick::new([\"needle-\", \"[REDACTED:\"])\n258\t            .context(\"failed to build safe-passthrough automaton\")?;\n259\t\n260\t        Ok(Sanitizer {\n261\t            rules,\n262\t            global_stopwords,\n263\t            global_allowlist_regexes,\n264\t            safe_passthrough,\n265\t        })\n266\t    }\n267\t\n268\t    /// Sanitize a string, replacing matched secrets with `[REDACTED:<rule-id>]`.\n269\t    ///\n270\t    /// Runs synchronously — must complete before any write to disk.\n271\t    pub fn sanitize(&self, text: &str) -> String {\n272\t        if text.len() < MIN_LINE_LEN {\n273\t            return text.to_string();\n274\t        }\n275\t\n276\t        let trailing_newline = text.ends_with('\\n');\n277\t        let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();\n278\t        let sanitized = lines\n279\t            .iter()\n280\t            .map(|line| self.sanitize_line(line))\n281\t            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n282\t            .join(\"\\n\");\n283\t\n284\t        if trailing_newline {\n285\t            sanitized + \"\\n\"\n286\t        } else {\n287\t            sanitized\n288\t        }\n289\t    }\n290\t\n291\t    fn sanitize_line(&self, line: &str) -> String {\n292\t        if line.len() < MIN_LINE_LEN {\n293\t            return line.to_string();\n294\t        }\n295\t\n296\t        let mut result = line.to_string();\n297\t        for rule in &self.rules {\n298\t            result = self.apply_rule(rule, &result, line);\n299\t        }\n300\t        result\n301\t    }\n302\t\n303\t    fn apply_rule(&self, rule: &CompiledRule, text: &str, original_line: &str) -> String {\n304\t        // Keyword pre-filter: if the rule declares keywords and none appear in\n305\t        // the lowercased text, skip the regex entirely.\n306\t        if let Some(ref ac) = rule.keywords {\n307\t            let lower = text.to_ascii_lowercase();\n308\t            if !ac.is_match(lower.as_bytes()) {\n309\t                return text.to_string();\n310\t            }\n311\t        }\n312\t\n313\t        let mut result = text.to_string();\n314\t        let mut scan_start = 0usize;\n315\t\n316\t        loop {\n317\t            // Search in the remaining tail of `result`.\n318\t            let haystack = &result[scan_start..];\n319\t            let caps = match rule.regex.captures(haystack) {\n320\t                Some(c) => c,\n321\t                None => break,\n322\t            };\n323\t\n324\t            let full_match = caps.get(0).unwrap();\n325\t\n326\t            // Determine which group holds the secret.\n327\t            let secret_match = if rule.secret_group > 0 && rule.secret_group < caps.len() {\n328\t                caps.get(rule.secret_group)\n329\t            } else if caps.len() > 1 {\n330\t                // Default: use group 1 when available.\n331\t                caps.get(1)\n332\t            } else {\n333\t                caps.get(0)\n334\t            };\n335\t\n336\t            let secret_m = match secret_match {\n337\t                Some(m) => m,\n338\t                None => {\n339\t                    scan_start += full_match.end();\n340\t                    continue;\n341\t                }\n342\t            };\n343\t\n344\t            let secret_str = secret_m.as_str();\n345\t\n346\t            // Entropy gate: skip low-entropy strings (placeholders, env var names).\n347\t            if let Some(threshold) = rule.entropy_threshold {\n348\t                if shannon_entropy(secret_str) < threshold {\n349\t                    scan_start += full_match.end();\n350\t                    continue;\n351\t                }\n352\t            }\n353\t\n354\t            // Global stopwords (lowercased comparison).\n355\t            let secret_lower = secret_str.to_lowercase();\n356\t            if self.global_stopwords.contains(&secret_lower) {\n357\t                scan_start += full_match.end();\n358\t                continue;\n359\t            }\n360\t\n361\t            // Global allowlist regexes checked against the secret.\n362\t            if self\n363\t                .global_allowlist_regexes\n364\t                .iter()\n365\t                .any(|r| r.is_match(secret_str))\n366\t            {\n367\t                scan_start += full_match.end();\n368\t                continue;\n369\t            }\n370\t\n371\t            // Known-safe passthrough: bead IDs, already-redacted strings.\n372\t            if self.safe_passthrough.is_match(secret_str.as_bytes()) {\n373\t                scan_start += full_match.end();\n374\t                continue;\n375\t            }\n376\t\n377\t            // Per-rule allowlist checks.\n378\t            let mut allowed = false;\n379\t            for (al_re, target) in &rule.allowlist_regexes {\n380\t                let subject = match target {\n381\t                    RegexTarget::Secret => secret_str,\n382\t                    RegexTarget::Match => full_match.as_str(),\n383\t                    RegexTarget::Line => original_line,\n384\t                };\n385\t                if al_re.is_match(subject) {\n386\t                    allowed = true;\n387\t                    break;\n388\t                }\n389\t            }\n390\t            if allowed {\n391\t                scan_start += full_match.end();\n392\t                continue;\n393\t            }\n394\t\n395\t            // Per-rule stopwords.\n396\t            if rule.allowlist_stopwords.contains(&secret_lower) {\n397\t                scan_start += full_match.end();\n398\t                continue;\n399\t            }\n400\t\n401\t            // Redact: replace only the secret group span with [REDACTED:<id>].\n402\t            let redaction = format!(\"[REDACTED:{}]\", rule.id);\n403\t\n404\t            let abs_secret_start = scan_start + secret_m.start();\n405\t            let abs_secret_end = scan_start + secret_m.end();\n406\t            let abs_full_end = scan_start + full_match.end();\n407\t\n408\t            result = format!(\n409\t                \"{}{}{}\",\n410\t                &result[..abs_secret_start],\n411\t                redaction,\n412\t                &result[abs_secret_end..]\n413\t            );\n414\t\n415\t            // Advance past the (now possibly length-changed) full match.\n416\t            let delta = redaction.len() as isize - (abs_secret_end - abs_secret_start) as isize;\n417\t            scan_start = ((abs_full_end as isize) + delta) as usize;\n418\t        }\n419\t\n420\t        result\n421\t    }\n422\t\n423\t    /// Number of successfully compiled rules (gitleaks + custom).\n424\t    pub fn rule_count(&self) -> usize {\n425\t        self.rules.len()\n426\t    }\n427\t\n428\t    /// Returns the embedded vendored gitleaks TOML text.\n429\t    pub fn vendored_toml() -> &'static str {\n430\t        GITLEAKS_TOML\n431\t    }\n432\t\n433\t    /// Measure keyword pre-filter skip statistics for given text.\n434\t    ///\n435\t    /// Returns statistics about how many rules were skipped by the\n436\t    /// Aho-Corasick keyword pre-filter (i.e., rules whose keywords\n437\t    /// were not found in the text, allowing them to be skipped\n438\t    /// without running the expensive regex).\n439\t    pub fn measure_skip_stats(&self, text: &str) -> SkipStats {\n440\t        let mut total_checks = 0usize;\n441\t        let mut skipped_by_keywords = 0usize;\n442\t\n443\t        for line in text.lines() {\n444\t            if line.len() < MIN_LINE_LEN {\n445\t                continue;\n446\t            }\n447\t\n448\t            let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();\n449\t            for rule in &self.rules {\n450\t                total_checks += 1;\n451\t                if let Some(ref ac) = rule.keywords {\n452\t                    if !ac.is_match(lower.as_bytes()) {\n453\t                        skipped_by_keywords += 1;\n454\t                    }\n455\t                }\n456\t            }\n457\t        }\n458\t\n459\t        SkipStats {\n460\t            total_checks,\n461\t            skipped_by_keywords,\n462\t            skip_rate: if total_checks > 0 {\n463\t                skipped_by_keywords as f64 / total_checks as f64\n464\t            } else {\n465\t                0.0\n466\t            },\n467\t        }\n468\t    }\n469\t}\n470\t\n471\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n472\t// Helpers\n473\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n474\t\n475\tfn compile_rule(spec: &RuleSpec) -> Option<CompiledRule> {\n476\t    // Path-only rules (e.g. pkcs12-file) have no regex — skip them silently.\n477\t    let raw_regex = spec.regex.as_deref()?;\n478\t    let normalized = normalize_regex(raw_regex);\n479\t    let regex = Regex::new(&normalized)\n480\t        .map_err(|e| {\n481\t            tracing::debug!(\n482\t                rule_id = %spec.id,\n483\t                error = %e,\n484\t                pattern = %raw_regex,\n485\t                \"gitleaks rule regex compile error\"\n486\t            );\n487\t        })\n488\t        .ok()?;\n489\t\n490\t    let keywords = if spec.keywords.is_empty() {\n491\t        None\n492\t    } else {\n493\t        let lower_kw: Vec<String> = spec.keywords.iter().map(|k| k.to_lowercase()).collect();\n494\t        AhoCorasick::new(&lower_kw)\n495\t            .map_err(|e| {\n496\t                tracing::debug!(\n497\t                    rule_id = %spec.id,\n498\t                    error = %e,\n499\t                    \"failed to build keyword automaton\"\n500\t                );\n501\t            })\n502\t            .ok()\n503\t    };\n504\t\n505\t    let mut allowlist_regexes: Vec<(Regex, RegexTarget)> = Vec::new();\n506\t    let mut allowlist_stopwords: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n507\t\n508\t    for al in &spec.allowlists {\n509\t        for al.regex_target)),\n513\t                Err(e) => tracing::debug!(\n514\t                    rule_id = %spec.id,\n515\t                    error = %e,\n516\t                    pattern = %re_str,\n517\t                    \"skipping invalid allowlist regex\"\n518\t                ),\n519\t            }\n520\t        }\n521\t        for sw in &al.stopwords {\n522\t            allowlist_stopwords.insert(sw.to_lowercase());\n523\t        }\n524\t    }\n525\t\n526\t    Some(CompiledRule {\n527\t        id: spec.id.clone(),\n528\t        regex,\n529\t        keywords,\n530\t        secret_group: spec.secret_group,\n531\t        entropy_threshold: spec.entropy,\n532\t        allowlist_regexes,\n533\t        allowlist_stopwords,\n534\t    })\n535\t}\n536\t\n537\t/// Normalize a gitleaks regex for compatibility with the Rust `regex` crate.\n538\t///\n539\t/// Converts POSIX character class syntax (`[[:alnum:]]` etc.) to equivalent\n540\t/// Rust regex syntax, which is RE2-based and does not support POSIX classes.\n541\tfn normalize_regex(pattern: &str) -> String {\n542\t    pattern\n543\t        .replace(\"[[:alnum:]]\", \"[a-zA-Z0-9]\")\n544\t        .replace(\"[[:alpha:]]\", \"[a-zA-Z]\")\n545\t        .replace(\"[[:digit:]]\", \"[0-9]\")\n546\t        .replace(\"[[:lower:]]\", \"[a-z]\")\n547\t        .replace(\"[[:upper:]]\", \"[A-Z]\")\n548\t        .replace(\"[[:space:]]\", r\"[\\t\\n\\r ]\")\n549\t        .replace(\"[[:print:]]\", r\"[\\x20-\\x7e]\")\n550\t        .replace(\"[[:ascii:]]\", r\"[\\x00-\\x7f]\")\n551\t}\n552\t\n553\t/// Calculate Shannon entropy of a string (base-2, over byte values).\n554\t///\n555\t/// Used to distinguish high-entropy secrets from low-entropy placeholders.\n556\tfn shannon_entropy(s: &str) -> f64 {\n557\t    if s.is_empty() {\n558\t        return 0.0;\n559\t    }\n560\t    let mut counts = [0u32; 256];\n561\t    for byte in s.bytes() {\n562\t        counts[byte as usize] += 1;\n563\t    }\n564\t    let len = s.len() as f64;\n565\t    counts\n566\t        .iter()\n567\t        .filter(|&&c| c > 0)\n568\t        .map(|&c| {\n569\t            let p = c as f64 / len;\n570\t            -p * p.log2()\n571\t        })\n572\t        .sum()\n573\t}\n574\t\n575\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n576\t// Tests\n577\t// result\\n421\\t    }\\n422\\t\\n423\\t    /// Number of successfully compiled rules (gitleaks + custom).\\n424\\t    pub fn rule_count(&self) -> usize {\\n425\\t        self.rules.len()\\n426\\t    }\\n427\\t\\n428\\t    /// Returns the embedded vendored gitleaks TOML text.\\n429\\t    pub fn vendored_toml() -> &'static str {\\n430\\t        GITLEAKS_TOML\\n431\\t    }\\n432\\t\\n433\\t    /// result\\n421\\t    }\\n422\\t\\n423\\t    /// Number of successfully compiled rules (gitleaks + custom).\\n424\\t    pub fn rule_count(&self) -> usize {\\n425\\t        self.rules.len()\\n426\\t    }\\n427\\t\\n428\\t    /// Returns the embedded vendored gitleaks TOML text.\\n429\\t    pub fn vendored_toml() -> &'static str {\\n430\\t        GITLEAKS_TOML\\n431\\t    }\\n432\\t\\n433\\t    ///
